nodes.title: SG-6.4.5 · Unit tests with mocked fetch for Reject, Approve, Retry and 401 behaviour
nodes.body:
Context: the frontend already has rejectExecution in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts, a Reject button in ExecutionPanel.tsx, and AdminApp.tsx handlers (runExecutionAction). Existing tests cover rejectExecution (executions.test.ts), the panel Reject button (executionReject.test.tsx) and AdminApp approve, retry and reject POSTs plus approve 401 and retry 500 (adminActions.test.tsx). Desired behavior: the remaining gaps (Retry 401, Reject 401, Reject failure display, id encoding in rejectExecution) are covered by passing unit tests. Expected result: all tests exist in the workspace and pass. Why: guards the admin approval workflow against regression.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when the reject endpoint returns 401, then the token gate shows 'Invalid token'
- Given a FAILED execution, when the retry endpoint returns 401, then the token gate shows 'Invalid token'
- Given a reject request that fails with 500 and a JSON error, when Reject is clicked, then the Execution region shows the server message in an alert
- Given an id containing reserved characters, when rejectExecution is called, then the URL path segment is percent-encoded
- Given the unit test files for these features, when they are run, then they all pass


## Scope
- In scope: Unit tests in game/frontend/tests for rejectExecution, ExecutionPanel Reject and AdminApp execution actions
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: New UI behavior
- Out of scope: Real network, browser or server tests
- Preserve: Existing passing tests
- Preserve: Current AdminApp, ExecutionPanel and client behavior


## Technical constraints
- Vitest with mocked global fetch only
- Fixtures follow the ExecutionInfo type in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts


## Definition of done
- All listed unit tests exist and pass
- No product behavior changed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A 401 from Retry or Reject returns AdminApp to the token gate
nodes.body:
Context: AdminApp.runExecutionAction routes a 401 ApiError to handleError, which clears the token and sets gateError 'Invalid token'. Only the Approve 401 is tested today. Desired behavior: Retry and Reject 401 are proven to behave identically. Expected result: the token input is shown with an Invalid token alert. Why: an expired admin token must never leave stale controls.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a FAILED execution, when Retry gets 401, then the gate shows an alert 'Invalid token' and the 'Admin token' field
- Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject gets 401, then the gate shows an alert 'Invalid token' and the 'Admin token' field


## Scope
- In scope: 401 handling for Retry and Reject in AdminApp
- Out of scope: Approve 401 (already tested)
- Preserve: handleError behavior


## Technical constraints
- Mocked fetch only


## Definition of done
- Retry and Reject 401 tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Reject failures and ids are handled by the client and AdminApp
nodes.body:
Context: rejectExecution uses encodeURIComponent on the id and AdminApp shows actionError and actionDetail on non-401 failures. Reject-specific failure display and id encoding are untested. Desired behavior: both are asserted by unit tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given id 'a/b c', when rejectExecution is called, then fetch receives '/api/v1/admin/executions/a%2Fb%20c/reject'
- Given Reject returns 500 {error:'boom'}, then the Execution region shows 'boom' in an alert


## Scope

- In scope: Reject failure display
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Existing reject tests
